title: Split-accumulate (blocked) reduction protects against a mid-stream magnitude spike (CUDA)
info: single thread; fixture is 30 ones, then [1e20, -1e20], then 32 more ones (64 elements); true sum is exactly 62.0
block_size=2 isolates the (1e20, -1e20) pair into its own block, so it cancels to exactly 0.0 without ever combining with a small value directly
